name: let's dive deeper into this one

messages.content:
let's dive deeper into this one - let's make it look more like a start-up

Suggest me different options, sections and categories to add.

I've come up with a platform idea - I see, we have hourly labors in tashkent that require the employer going to the place physically and negotiate the price and choose the person - which is costly because the employer is usually in a car which means the gas is being burnt, and tashkent is becoming trafically congested more and more.

there will be a platform just like "Joyme" where both parties - employer and laborer will have an account, employers post their requirements, all the details and the price range of the labor they are willing to pay for a certain period. Laborers will find the posts, click on that and leave a request or call the author of the post and negotiate with them.

The payment can be done in advance, or after the job is finished - through the app so that we can also earn some money from the comission on the transaction. There will also be a rating system just like in yandex or wildberries so that the employers can see the profile and the history of the laborer.

Let me know if you have questions
